title: COLEMAN CO., INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE (565 affected)
summary: STOVE MAY HAVE A CRACKED GAS MANIFOLD WHICH PERMITS A LEAKAGE OF PROPANE GAS.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS (405 affected)
summary: THE TUBES PROVIDED AS HANDHOLDS MAY CRACK OR FRACTURE WHERE THE STEPS AND ATTACHING BRACKETS ARE JOINED.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (4,773 affected)
summary: A BOLT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY TIGHTENED ON THE PITMAN ARM AND RETAINING SCREWS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED OR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY TIGHTENED. THE PITMAN ARM COULD SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING SHAFT.

title: Lodal, Inc.: STEERING:UNKNOWN TYPE:GEAR BOX (160 affected)
summary: THE ASSEMBLY THAT CONNECTS THE STEERING SHAFT TO THE STEERING GEAR HAS A LOOSE CONNECTION WHICH ALLOWS EXCESSIVE PLAY IN THE STEERING WHEEL.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS:LOCKING MECHANISM (3,320 affected)
summary: COMPONENTS IN THE LOCKING HUBS WERE IMPROPERLY HEAT-TREATED AND MAY CRACK OR FRACTURE UPON ENGAGEMENT OF THE FRONT DRIVE AXLES. THE BROKEN COMPONENT ON THE LEFT FRONT WHEEL MAY BECOME JAMMED AGAINST THE NUT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:HOUSING:AXLE SHAFT (8,126 affected)
summary: IMPROPER ASSEMBLY OF THE REAR AXLE MAY CAUSE AXLE BEARING FAILURE AND COULD RESULT IN THE SEPARATION OF A REAR AXLE AND WHEEL.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR:RACK AND PINION (75,284 affected)
summary: A PROTECTIVE BOOT COVERING THE STEERING RACK AND PINION SHAFT CAN COME LOOSE IN EXTREME COLD. WHEN UNPROTECTED, THE RACK SHAFT MAY CORRODE, RESULTING IN HARD OR STIFF STEERING.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL (139 affected)
summary: VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT BRAKE PEDAL BRACKET WHICH CAUSES THE BRAKE PEDAL TO BE LOCATED IN A POSITION LOWER THAN NORMAL.

title: FIRESTONE STEEL PROD. CO.: WHEELS (1,038 affected)
summary: IMPROPER WELDING BETWEEN THE DISK AND RIM ALLOWS FATIGUE CRACKS AFTER EXTENDED USE.

title: HOUSEHOLD MFG. INC.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (217 affected)
summary: BLADE BENDING STRESSES ARE HIGHER THAN EXPECTED. INCREASED BLADE BENDING STRESSES ARE A RESULT OF RESONANT VIBRATION AT CERTAIN ENGINE SPEEDS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING (41,119 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE BOLTS IN THE STEERING SYSTEM THAT WERE NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:UNDER DASH (779 affected)
summary: THE MAIN FEED WIRE AND HORN RELAY-FLASHER FEED WIRE MAY HAVE BEEN CONNECTED IN REVERSE POSITIONS IN THE NUMBER TWO CIRCUIT BREAKER IN THE DRIVER"S CONTROL PANEL.

title: WAYNE WHEELED VEHICLES: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (14 affected)
summary: ONLY TWO SEAT BELTS WERE INSTALLED ON THE 39 INCH BENCH SEAT; THE CENTER BELT WAS OMITTED. VEHICLES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 222, SCHOOL BUS PASSENGER SEATING CRASH PROTECTION.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:SLEEVE:TIE ROD:ADJUSTABLE (767 affected)
summary: THE FRONT STEERING ALIGNMENT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED. THE TIE RODS, A PART OF THE STEERING LINKAGE WHICH TRANSMITS STEERING MOVEMENTS TO THE WHEELS, MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FASTENED COMPLETELY. THE ALIGNMENT OF THE STEERING WILL AFFECT THE VEHICLE"S HANDLING PROPERTIES. INCOMPLETE FASTENING OF THE STEERING TIE ROD MAY LEAD TO COMPLETE SEPARATION OF THE LINKAGE.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:BEAD (410 affected)
summary: NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARDS 109 AND 119, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. TIRES MAY CONTAIN AN OFF STANDARD COMPOUND IN BEAD AREA.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:METALLIC (1,163 affected)
summary: FRONT AXLE AIR BRAKE LINES ARE ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE ENGINE EXHAUST MANIFOLD. THIS CAN PERMIT BRAKE LINES TO MELT AND RUPTURE, CAUSING A REDUCTION IN AIR PRESSURE TO BRAKE CHAMBERS UPON BRAKE APPLICATION.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (4,393 affected)
summary: IMPROPER STEERING CLAMP BOLTS AND TORQUE APPLIED DURING INSTALLATION. THE BOLT COULD FAIL, ALLOWING THE STEERING YOKE TO BECOME LOOSE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (4,000 affected)
summary: ATTACHING BOLTS ON FUEL TANK SUPPORTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED; ALSO, THE SUPPORTS ARE TOO THIN. HIGH LEVELS OF STRESS, WHICH COULD OCCUR UNDER NORMAL OPERATING CONDITIONS, COULD CAUSE CRACKS TO DEVELOP IN THE SUPPORT STRAPS. IF THE FUEL TANK SUPPORTS FRACTURE, THE FUEL TANK WILL SLIP FROM THE NORMAL POSITION, AND FUEL LEAKAGE COULD RESULT.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:CHECK VALVE (850 affected)
summary: A MANUFACTURING ERROR RESULTED IN THE INSTALLATION OF CARBON STEEL SPRINGS IN SOME DUAL-COMPARTMENT AIR RESERVOIR CHECK VALVES. CARBON STEEL SPRINGS ARE INADEQUATE FOR THIS APPLICATION BECAUSE THEY ARE SUBJECT TO SEVERE CORROSION AND SUBSEQUENT FAILURE OF THE CHECK VALVE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY (3,421 affected)
summary: SPRING SEAT CAN DEFORM, WHICH CAUSES A DECREASE IN THE CLAMPING FORCE IN THE SUSPENSION ASSEMBLY. LOSS OF CLAMPING FORCE MAY BRING ABOUT AXLE MISALIGNMENT OR AXLE HOUSING FAILURE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (295 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED LIQUID/VAPOR SEPARATOR IS INSTALLED IN TANK. WHEN FUEL TANK IS FILLED TO MAXIMUM CAPACITY, FUEL LEAKAGE CAN OCCUR UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL (489 affected)
summary: DAMAGE TO COTTER PIN DURING ASSEMBLY OR FROM TILTING CAB FOR SERVICE COULD CAUSE BRAKE LINKAGE SEPARATION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): WHEELS (130 affected)
summary: THE DISC/RIM ARC WELDS WERE IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED (NOT STRONG ENOUGH). UNDER SEVERE OPERATING CONDITIONS, CRACKS CAN FORM IN THE WELDS FASTENING WHEEL RIMS TO CENTER DISCS. CRACKED WELDS MAY ALLOW AIR TO ESCAPE FROM THE TIRES OR CAUSE WHEELS TO FAIL.

title: MCGRAW: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:ROTOR:DISC HUB (3,422 affected)
summary: BRAKE HUB ROTORS WERE NOT MANUFACTURED TO THE PROPER SPECIFICATIONS, CAUSING MISALIGNMENT AND EVENTUAL FAILURE OF THE OUTER WHEEL BEARING.

title: HOUSEHOLD MFG. INC.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (69 affected)
summary: BLADE BENDING STRESSES ARE HIGHER THAN EXPECTED, SPECIFICALLY WITH DIESEL ENGINES GOVERNED AT 1800 RPM AND WITH FANS OPERATING AT 1.2 TIMES THE ENGINE CRANKSHAFT SPEED. INCREASED BLADE BENDING STRESSES ARE A RESULT OF RESONANT VIBRATION AT CERTAIN VEHICLE OPERATING MODES.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR (181 affected)
summary: ALTERED VEHICLES EITHER DO NOT HAVE REAR COUCH SEAT BELTS INSTALLED, VIOLATING FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 208, OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION, OR HAVE REAR COUCH SEAT BELTS WHICH DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 210, SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (1,296 affected)
summary: LIQUID/VAPOR SEPARATOR PIPE JOINT WAS IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED AT THE BASE OF THE MAIN FUEL TANK. WHEN MAIN FUEL TANK IS FILLED UP TO THE PIPE JOINT, FUEL MAY LEAK INTO THE DRAIN TUBE AND EVENTUALLY TO THE GROUND BELOW THE MOTORCYCLE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (8,500 affected)
summary: ENGINE COOLING FAN IS MADE OF A PLASTIC OUTER RING AND BLADE MOLDED TO A METAL CENTER. THE FAN BLADES CAN SEPARATE FROM THE HUB AND DISINTEGRATE WITHOUT WARNING.
